scope: static provider/import audit plus bounded temporary-repository probes; no corpus build

provider_patterns.why: All SOURCES.jsonl providers are discovered dynamically; records can direct source text_path to any file in any jobs/*/output subtree; signing-date discovery scans arbitrary jobs/*/output/*.csv; working_text scans FRAGMENTS*.jsonl; app archive captures are read from jobs/app-executive-orders/output/MIRROR_DOCUMENTS.jsonl.
All jobs/*/data/PROVENANCE.json providers are scanned, nested FRAGMENTS*.jsonl are discovered by working_text, and records can name arbitrary nested data.

Stage 18/20/21 custody records contain path-valued local files; Norton factual registries can name repository-root-relative raw_path and text_path; Pinakes replica fragments can name repository-root-relative raw file paths. The current code does not constrain these paths to a narrower research subdirectory.
Nested PROVENANCE.json records select arbitrary paths beginning releases/ (the loader does not limit them to releases/source_books); Opus release and media ZIPs are also read here.

provider_details.sources_jsonl: Every jobs/*/output/SOURCES.jsonl; fields sha256,url,bytes,text_path,cache_path,instrument_ids. text_path is confined to some jobs/<job>/output by _jobs_child. cache_path resolves only in sibling/out/cache roots and is non-repository runtime cache state.
provider_details.documents_jsonl: No checker path reads a DOCUMENTS.jsonl file. Generic source custody is consumed from SOURCES.jsonl; the distinct archive adapter reads only the fixed MIRROR_DOCUMENTS.jsonl path below.
provider_details.mirror_documents_jsonl: jobs/app-executive-orders/output/MIRROR_DOCUMENTS.jsonl, exact literal ARCHIVE_CAPTURE_FILES entry, supplies Common Crawl/Wayback capture pointers for re-fetch verification.
provider_details.fragments: working_text.Index scans jobs/*/output/FRAGMENTS*.jsonl and jobs/*/data/**/FRAGMENTS*.jsonl. sources.load_source_books scans each data/PROVENANCE.json-selected job's output/FRAGMENTS.jsonl for per-order volume text; sources.load_replica_fragments reads Pinakes output/FRAGMENTS.jsonl.
provider_details.source_books: Every jobs/*/data/PROVENANCE.json recursively contributes pdf/pdf_sha256 records; current path check accepts any safe path under releases/. Current known records use releases/source_books; code permits a broader release subtree.
provider_details.stage18: research/stage18/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json recursively discovers sha256/path pairs; local paths are resolved relative to research/stage18 and rejected if they escape that folder.
provider_details.stage21: CASE_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_CUSTODY.csv and ACQUISITION_LOG.jsonl resolve source_repository_path/repository_path from repo root without a subdirectory whitelist.
provider_details.stage20: STATUTE_FETCH_INDEX.csv and OPUS_ORIGINAL_MEDIA_MEMBER_MAP.csv; statute local_relpath is repo-root-relative and media companions point into releases/opus_stage11_complete ZIP.
provider_details.official_fixity: jobs/official-fixity/output/MATCHED_BY_SHA256.json is an additional literal checker provider for GPO hash matches.
provider_details.opus: jobs/claim-checker/data/opus_manifest_index.csv.gz and optional data/opus_text_pack.jsonl.gz; otherwise releases/opus_stage11_complete ZIPs.

unavoidable_breadth: The declarations now cover all observed dynamic provider trees (jobs outputs/data, research, releases). A complete static certificate still cannot bound repo-root-relative Stage 20/21, Pinakes, and Norton factual raw_path/text_path references: current implementation accepts any in-repository path. Closing this without a full-checkout declaration requires implementation-level path constraints or an exact run-specific scan of all active provider records and every referenced body.
